thig6.8:1.1: catukkhatuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ vihārā upanikkhamiṃ | aladdhā cetaso santiṃ citte avasavattini. || ||
thig6.8:2.1: bhikkhuniṃ upasaṅkamma sakkaccaṃ paripucch' ahaṃ | sā me dhammam adesesi dhātuāyatanāni ca. || ||
thig6.8:3.1: cattāri ariyasaccāni indriyāni balāni ca | bojjhaṅgaṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ uttamatthassa pattiyā. || ||
thig6.8:4.1: tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā karontī anusāsaniṃ | rattiyā purime yāme pubbajātim anussariṃ || ||
thig6.8:5.1: rattiyā majjhime yāme dibbacakkhuṃ visodhayiṃ | rattiyā pacchime yāme tamokkhandhaṃ padālayiṃ. || ||
thig6.8:6.1: pītisukhena ca kāyaṃ pharitvā vihariṃ tadā | sattamiyā pāde pasāremi tamokkhandhaṃ padāliya. || || Vijayā. ||
